subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “After several weeks, parents noticed their children asking more questions about weather and plants.”?
options: One student asked if drinking coffee could replace sleep.
The forest did not replace the classroom.
The students became more careful on forest trails.
The old classroom felt both strange and familiar.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「One student asked if drinking coffee could replace sleep.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「After several weeks, parents noticed their children asking more questions about weather and plants. The forest did not replace the classroom.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The students became more careful on forest trails.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The old classroom felt both strange and familiar.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「After several weeks, parents noticed their children asking more questions about weather and plants. The forest did not replace the classroom.」，答案為「The forest did not replace the classroom.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The forest did not replace the classroom.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
